title: Portkey
description: You set the target of a portkey by right clicking a block with it. When thrown on the ground the enchantment glint will vanish after 5 seconds, the portkey is now primed and won't despawn anymore. When picked up by a player in the same dimension as the target that player will be teleported to the target of the portkey (Anywhere within 2 blocks of the target to be precise, on a solid block with room to stand, up to 10 blocks below the target height). If there is no such spot, the portkey is picked up normally. A portkey without a target never teleports. Combining the portkey with any other item in a crafting table will allow you to change the appearance of the key; the other item is not used up.

properties.label: Config
properties.value: HideCoordinates (default false): hides the target coordinates in the tooltip
